lessons.en: POWERS WITH NATURAL EXPONENTS OF RATIONAL NUMBERS

cards.ex: Calculate the value of the fourth power of −3, which is (−3)⁴ = 81.
In the power expression x^{n}, the rational number x is called the base.
The exponent n represents the number of equal factors multiplied together.
In Grade 7, we first learn about powers of rational numbers with a natural exponent n ∈ ℕ.
The power x^{n} is defined as the product of n equal factors x.
The product of two powers with the same base is obtained by adding their exponents: x^{m} · x^{n} = x^{m+n}.
To find the quotient of two powers with the same base, subtract the exponent of the divisor: x^{m} : x^{n} = x^{m−n}.
We can simplify the expression easily because both terms have the same base: 5³ and 5².
According to the exponent rules, the power of a product is written as (x · y)^{n} = x^{n} · y^{n}.
The power of a quotient is the quotient of the powers: (x/y)^{n} = x^{n}/y^{n}.
When we raise a power to another power, we multiply the exponents: (x^{m})^{n} = x^{m · n}.
Any rational number raised to the power 0 is equal to 1: x⁰ = 1.
When a non-zero number is raised to the power 0, the result is 1: x ≠ 0 ⇒ x⁰ = 1.
A rational number can be written as a fraction a/b where a, b ∈ ℤ and b ≠ 0.

cards.ex: The target population of our survey is all students currently enrolled in Grade 7.
Examine the following data sequence containing the favorite subjects of ten students.
The weights of the students form a numerical sequence: 43, 41, 48, 45, 52.
The conclusion is reasonable because the survey sample was truly representative.

cards.vi: thiên lệch / thiếu tính đại diện
cards.ex: Only surveying members of the soccer club to find the school's favorite sport will result in a biased conclusion.

dlg.text: Hello class! If we want to find out the favorite sport of all students in our school, how should we collect our data?
We can just ask all the members of the school's soccer club, Mr. Pi!
What do you think of Tron's idea, Vuong?
That would be biased, sir! Soccer club members will definitely choose soccer. That data lacks representativeness!
Spot on, Vuong! So Tron, how can we make our survey reasonable?
Ah! We should choose a random group of 10 students from each class in our school instead!
Excellent! Choosing a random sample ensures representativeness and leads to a reasonable conclusion. You have mastered Lesson 17!
Awesome! Data collection in English is so useful and logical!

lessons.vi: Biểu đồ hình quạt tròn

cards.ex: A pie chart is used to compare the parts of a whole data set.
The entire circle of a pie chart represents 100% of the collected data.
Each sector in the pie chart represents the percentage of a specific category.
Calculate the percentage of students who prefer reading books in their free time.
In this graph, the circle represents the whole of 500 surveyed students.
Before drawing a pie chart, we must collect and classify the data.
This yellow sector represents the percentage of gold medals won by the team.
To draw the chart, we divide the circle into sectors proportional to the quantities.
Look at the legend of the pie chart to understand what each color means.
The title of the pie chart must clearly describe the content of the statistical data.
Use the statistical table below to find the exact percentage of each book type.
We can easily compare different groups by looking at the sizes of the sectors in a pie chart.
Analyze the pie chart to find out which continent has the highest population.
Predict the approximate number of students who like playing sports out of 1000 pupils.
We can estimate the total budget based on the percentage contribution of each department.
The main components of a pie chart include the title, the circle, the sectors, and the legend.
The sector representing 50% corresponds to exactly half of the circle.
A quarter of the circle represents a proportion of 25% of the total data.
The sum of the percentages of all sectors in a pie chart must always equal 100%.
Substitute the total sample size to find the numerical value represented by each sector.

dlg.text: Today we learn about pie charts! If the pie chart is about 200 students, and the sports sector represents 30%, how many students like sports?
Let me calculate, Mr. Pi! 30% of 200 is 60! So, there are exactly 60 students who like playing sports!
Excellent, Tron! Now, Vuong, how about the reading sector which represents a quarter of the circle?
A quarter of the circle is 25%, Mr. Pi! So, 25% of 200 is 50 students who like reading!
Outstanding! You have both mastered analyzing and calculating values from pie charts perfectly!
Learning math in English is extremely clear and fun!

lessons.vi: Biểu đồ đoạn thẳng

cards.ex: A line graph is commonly used to represent the change of a quantity over time.
The horizontal axis of this line graph represents the time intervals in years.
The vertical axis represents the temperature in Hanoi measured in degrees Celsius.
Each data point on the line graph represents a specific value of the measurement quantity at a given time.
In a line graph, two consecutive data points are joined by a straight line segment.
The general trend of the graph shows that the population of Vietnam has steadily increased.
The line graph segment goes up to show an increase in the number of computer sales.
We can see a sharp decrease in the number of international tourists arriving in 2020.
The slope of the segment tells us how fast the plant's height has changed each day.
A steeper slope on the graph indicates a much faster growth rate of the tree.
Make sure to write the axis title clearly, such as "Number of Students (thousands)".
The horizontal axis represents the time intervals such as days, months, or years.
The vertical axis measures the quantity of interest, such as the height or weight of an object.
Choose an appropriate unit of measurement, such as centimeters for height or seconds for time.
The segment from day 4 to day 5 is very steep, meaning the plant grew extremely fast.
A flat horizontal segment on the line graph indicates that the values remained constant.

cards.vi: biến động / dao động lên xuống
cards.ex: The temperature of Hanoi on an autumn day fluctuates constantly from morning to night.
We can represent the athlete's running times on a line graph to see their training progress.
Analyze the line graph to predict the future sales trends of the store next month.
Each point is determined by a horizontal coordinate and a vertical coordinate.

dlg.text: Welcome back! Today we analyze line graphs. Tron, what do the horizontal and vertical axes show here?
The horizontal axis represents the days, and the vertical axis shows the plant's height in centimeters, Mr. Pi!
Excellent! And how do we represent the height on day 3?
We find day 3 on the horizontal axis and go up to meet the corresponding coordinate point, which is 1 cm!
Spot on! Now Vuong, on which day did the plant grow the fastest?
Between day 4 and day 5, sir! The line segment there is extremely steep, indicating a very rapid growth rate!
Outstanding analysis! You both have mastered Lesson 19 completely. Analyzing line graphs in English is so fun!
Yes, Mr. Pi! It is incredibly clear, logical, and easy to explain in English!

lessons.vi: Tỉ lệ thức

cards.ex: A proportion is an equality of two ratios, written as a/b = c/d.
The ratio of the width to the length of Lũng Cú national flag is 6/9 or 2/3.
The statement 6/9 = 0.8/1.2 is a valid algebraic equality.
In any proportion, the cross products are equal, which means a · d = b · c.
To solve for x in x/6 = −3/4, we cross multiply to get 4x = 6 · (−3).
An important property of proportions allows us to swap the terms to create new proportions.
Express the ratio 10/15 as a simplest fraction, which is 2/3.
Despite different dimensions, all standard national flags share the same ratio of 2:3.
Nam drew a mock-up of Mỹ Đình stadium with a length of 21 cm and a width of 13.6 cm.
Check if the mock-up scale matches the actual stadium dimensions of 105 m by 68 m.
The actual width of the football field is 68 meters.
The actual length of the football field is 105 meters.
To find x in x/6 = −3/4, calculate x = 6 · (−3)/4.
The ratio between width and length remains constant for all official flags.
We should convert the ratios to be between integers to easily compare them.
We can rearrange the terms in a proportion to establish new equal ratios.
Let the variable x represent the unknown amount of water needed to mix the saline solution.
To prepare saline solution, mix 27 g of salt with every 3 liters of purified water.
Assuming the productivity of each tractor is identical, we can solve the work timeline.
Solve the proportion to find out how many tractors are needed to plow the field.

dlg.text: Good morning! Can anyone calculate the ratio of the width to the length of this flag?
Yes, Mr. Pi! The ratio is 6 to 9, which simplifies to the simplest fraction of 2/3!
Excellent, Tron! If a paper flag has a length of 21 cm, how do we find its width x?
We set up a proportion: x/21 = 2/3, and then we cross multiply to solve it!
Splendid, Vuong! What is the final value of x?
By cross multiplying, 3 times x equals 42, which means the width x is exactly 14 cm!
Outstanding! You have mastered proportions, cross products, and scales perfectly today!
Hooray! Setting up proportions in English is so logical and elegant!

lessons.en: PROPERTIES OF A SERIES OF EQUAL RATIOS
lessons.vi: Tính chất của dãy tỉ số bằng nhau

cards.ex: We can write a series of equal ratios under the form x/3 = y/5 = z/7.
The money contributed by three donors is proportional to the numbers 3, 5, and 7.
The ratio of the share of the first investor to the second is 2 : 3.
The property of equal ratios allows us to add or subtract the numerators: a + c + e.
Remember that all denominators in the ratios must be non-zero: b + d + f ≠ 0.
We can solve the real-world allocation problem by utilizing the mathematical property of equal ratios.
We can extend this rule to a series of three or more equal ratios.
Apply the property of the series of equal ratios to find the unknown variables x and y.
The sum of the three variables x + y + z represents the total fund of 450 million VND.
We are given that the difference between the two numbers is twelve: x − y = 12.
Three investors contributed capital to open a new company according to the ratio 2 : 3 : 4.

cards.vi: sự đóng góp / phần góp vốn
cards.ex: Determine the individual contribution of each philanthropist to build the school rooms.
The company's profit of 72 million VND is shared proportionally among the three partners.

cards.vi: nhà từ thiện / người hiến tặng
cards.ex: The three donors contributed a total sum of 450 million VND to build the school rooms.
The property of the series of equal ratios states the equality of the newly formed ratios.
They decided to divide the profit based on their initial capital ratio.
Let the variables x, y, and z represent the contributed money of each donor.
Solve the system of equations by utilizing the property of equal ratios.
How much profit will each investor share from the investment?
Express the ratio in its simplest form to simplify the calculation process.

dlg.text: Welcome back, class! How do we find each donor's contribution? The total fund is 450 million VND and the ratio is 3 : 5 : 7.
We can represent the contributions as variables x, y, and z, such that x + y + z = 450!
Excellent, Tron! Since they are proportional to 3, 5, and 7, what is our next step?
We set up a series of equal ratios: x/3 = y/5 = z/7!
Spot on, Vuong! How do we apply the property to solve for the variables?
We add the numerators and denominators: (x + y + z)/(3 + 5 + 7) = 450/15 = 30!
Brilliant! So, what are the final contributions of each donor?
Multiplying the ratio value of 30, we get 90, 150, and 210 million VND, Mr. Pi!

lessons.vi: Đại lượng tỉ lệ thuận

cards.ex: If a variable y is directly proportional to x, then any increase in x causes a proportional increase in y.
In the formula y = ax, the non-zero constant a is called the constant of proportionality.
Mass and volume are two physical quantities that are directly proportional for any homogeneous material.
The ratio of two corresponding values y1/x1 is always constant and equal to the coefficient a.
Determine the corresponding value of y when the independent variable x is equal to 3.

cards.vi: mối quan hệ / quan hệ phụ thuộc
cards.ex: The formula s = 60t represents the directly proportional relation between distance and time.
The speed of the car remains constant at 60 km/h during the entire uniform motion.
We can write the formula y = −2x to calculate the dependent values in this exercise.
In a direct variation, the dependent variable changes at a constant rate relative to the independent variable.
The mass of protein in a soybean portion is directly proportional to the total mass of the soybeans.
A copper bar has a mass that increases proportionally as its volume expands.
Calculate the volume of a homogeneous block when its mass is given.
The hot-air balloon rises vertically with a constant velocity of 0.8 m/s.
In a uniform motion, distance is directly proportional to time according to the physics formula.
Find the total distance traveled by the train after moving at a constant speed for 4.5 hours.
We can model the mass of protein in food items using linear proportion equations.
If the independent variable increases three times, the dependent variable must also increase three times.
A decrease in the volume of the container leads to a proportional decrease in its holding capacity.
The masses of two homogeneous metal bars are directly proportional to their respective volumes.

cards.vi: biến độc lập / biến tự do
cards.ex: On a graph, the independent variable x is plotted on the horizontal axis.

dlg.text: Welcome! If a car travels at a constant speed of 60 km/h, how are distance and time related?
They are directly proportional! Distance increases proportionally as time increases! The formula is s = 60t!
Spot on, Tron! And what do we call the constant speed 60 in this relation?
That is our constant of proportionality, Mr. Pi! It is the ratio of distance to time!
Excellent! If the car travels for 2.5 hours, what is the corresponding distance?
We use the formula: s = 60 · 2.5. The distance traveled is exactly 150 km!
Outstanding! You have mastered directly proportional quantities and formulas today!
Doing English math is incredibly fun and logical!

lessons.vi: Đại lượng tỉ lệ nghịch
lessons.focus: Understanding inverse proportional relationships and solving real-world problems

cards.ex: If a variable y is inversely proportional to x, any increase in x causes a proportional decrease in y.
In the inverse variation y = a/x, the non-zero constant a is called the constant of proportionality.
The number of workers and the time required to complete the wall are two inversely proportional quantities.
The product of any two corresponding values of inversely proportional variables is always constant: x1 y1 = x2 y2 = a.

cards.vi: nghịch đảo / tỉ số nghịch đảo
cards.ex: The ratio of two values of one quantity equals the reciprocal ratio of their corresponding values of the other.
Find the corresponding value of y when the independent variable x increases from 2 to 4.

cards.vi: mối quan hệ / quan hệ phụ thuộc
cards.ex: The equation v · t = 180 describes the inversely proportional relation between speed and time.
The area of the rectangular sheets of paper remains constant at 12 cm².
We can write the formula y = −8/x to calculate the dependent values in this exercise.
In an inverse variation, the dependent variable decreases at a fractional rate relative to the independent variable.
The time t required to travel a fixed distance is inversely proportional to the speed v.
All rectangles in this set have the same area of 12 cm² but different lengths and widths.
If the area is fixed, the dimensions of length and width vary inversely with each other.
As the width of the rectangle decreases, its length must increase to maintain the same area.
For a constant area, the length is inversely proportional to the width.
The velocity of the vehicle is inversely proportional to the time it takes to reach the destination.
If we double the velocity, the travel time is reduced by exactly half.
Assuming the work capacity of each worker is identical, we can use inverse proportion to solve the timeline.

cards.vi: lực lượng lao động / số thợ
cards.ex: A larger workforce will significantly reduce the number of days needed to complete the construction.
Solve the division problem of buying eggs by setting up equal products: 4x = 3y = 2z.

dlg.text: Good morning class! If 4 workers take 9 days to build a wall, how many days will 6 workers take?
Let's think. If there are more workers, the time needed must decrease, Mr. Pi!
Spot on, Tron! This means the number of workers and the days are what?
They are inversely proportional quantities! Their product must remain constant!
Excellent! Vuong, how do we write this relation as a formula?
We set up equal products: 6 · x = 4 · 9. The constant of proportionality is 36!
Perfect! So, what is the final value of x?
By solving it, x = 36/6 = 6 days! 6 workers will build the wall in exactly 6 days!

lessons.vi: Biểu thức đại số

cards.ex: The expression 50t is an algebraic expression representing the distance an automobile travels in t hours.
The expression 23 + 8 · 9 is a numerical expression because it contains only numbers and operations.
In the algebraic expression 3a + b, the letters a and b are called variables.
To find the value of an expression, substitute the given numbers for the variables.
Substitute p = 5 and q = 7 into the expression 3p − q to get 3 · 5 − 7 = 8.
The automobile travels with a constant speed of 50 km/h.
Write an algebraic expression representing the perimeter of a rectangle with width x.
The area of a trapezoid is represented by the algebraic expression (a + b) · h / 2.
A trapezoid has two parallel bases, denoted as the lower base a and the upper base b.
The height h of the trapezoid is the perpendicular distance between its two parallel bases.
Evaluate the expression 4x + 3 when the variable x = 5.8.
Numerical and algebraic terms are connected together by the symbols of arithmetic operations.
We can write the product x · x · x as a power of the variable: x³.
Apply the distributive property to expand the expression: x(y + z) = xy + xz.
The commutative property of addition states that x + y = y + x.
We use the associative property to group terms differently without changing the total value.
An expression can consist of numbers, variables, operations, and grouping symbols.
In the term 40x, the number 40 is the coefficient multiplied by the variable x.
On a graph, the independent variable is typically plotted on the horizontal axis.
We can simplify the expression by combining like terms: x + x = 2x.

dlg.text: Look at this expression: 40x + 15. Is it a numerical expression or an algebraic expression?
It contains the letter x, so it is an algebraic expression, Mr. Pi!
Correct, Tron! What do we call the letter x in this expression?
It is called a variable, representing an unknown or changing number!
Excellent! Now, if we substitute x = 2.5, what is the final value of this expression?
We evaluate it: 40 · 2.5 + 15 = 115. The value is exactly 115, Mr. Pi!
Outstanding! You have both mastered algebraic expressions and variables beautifully today!
Hooray! Doing math in English is extremely logical and fun to explain!

lessons.vi: Đa thức một biến

cards.ex: The expression P(x) = 2x³ − 5x² + 7 is a polynomial in one variable x.
A monomial is an algebraic expression that is a product of a number and a power of a variable.
In the monomial −5x², the real number −5 is called the coefficient.
The degree of the monomial 3x⁵ is 5.
The polynomial 2x³ − 5x² + 7 has three terms: 2x³, −5x², and 7.
The number 0 is also considered a polynomial, called the zero polynomial.
We simplify a polynomial by combining all of its like terms.
We usually arrange the terms of a polynomial in descending powers of the variable.
Arrange the polynomial −3x⁴ + 5x² − 2x + 1 in descending powers of x.
The degree of a polynomial is the highest degree of its terms in simplified form.
In the polynomial P(x) = −3x⁴ + 5x² − 2x + 1, the leading coefficient is −3.

cards.vi: hệ số tự do / hạng tử tự do
cards.ex: The constant term of the polynomial is the term of degree 0, which does not contain the variable.
A number x = a is a root of a polynomial P(x) if P(a) = 0.
In the polynomial H(x) = −5x² + 15x, the letter x is the variable.
Calculate the value of the polynomial H(x) at x = 2.
The highest power of the variable is 2, so its degree is 2.
The leading coefficient is −5, and since it lacks a standalone number, the constant term is 0.
Combine the like terms 6x³ and −4x³ to simplify the polynomial.

cards.vi: nhị thức / nhị thức bậc nhất
cards.ex: A first-degree polynomial like ax + b is also called a binomial.

cards.vi: tam thức / tam thức bậc hai
cards.ex: The quadratic polynomial ax² + bx + c is commonly referred to as a trinomial.

dlg.text: Good morning class! Look at this polynomial H(x) = −5x² + 15x. What is its degree?
The highest power of the variable is 2, so its degree is 2, Mr. Pi!
Excellent, Tron! What are its leading coefficient and constant term?
The leading coefficient is −5, and since it lacks a standalone number, the constant term is 0!
Wonderful! Now, if we substitute x = 3, what is the value of H(x)?
We get H(3) = −5 · 3² + 15 · 3 = −45 + 45 = 0. So x = 3 is a root of the polynomial!
Perfect! Thus, when the object is thrown up, it falls back to the ground after exactly 3 seconds!
Hooray! Solving real-world physics problems with polynomials in English is so logical and clear!

lessons.en: ADDITION AND SUBTRACTION OF ONE-VARIABLE POLYNOMIALS
lessons.vi: Phép cộng và phép trừ đa thức một biến

cards.ex: The expression P(x) = x⁴ + 3x³ − 5x² + 7x is a polynomial.
The polynomial A(x) = 2x² + 6x is a one-variable polynomial with variable x.
The addition of two polynomials can be done by grouping like terms.
Be careful with the signs of coefficients when performing polynomial subtraction.
Find the sum P(x) + Q(x) by adding the coefficients of like terms.
The difference between two polynomials P(x) and Q(x) is written as P(x) − Q(x).
The polynomial 2x³ − 5x² + 7 consists of three distinct terms.
Group like terms together such as 3x³ and −5x³ before simplifying.
In the algebraic term −5x², the coefficient is the real number −5.
The polynomial P(x) uses the letter x as its main variable.
The degree of the polynomial 2x³ − 5x² + 7 is three.

cards.vi: đặt thẳng hàng / đặt thẳng cột
cards.ex: Align the terms of the same degree vertically before performing addition.
Add or subtract the coefficients in each vertical column to get the result.
To find the sum, add the corresponding coefficients of like terms.
Subtract the coefficients of each column when doing vertical polynomial subtraction.
Group all like terms together and simplify the resulting polynomial.
Polynomial addition satisfies the commutative property: P(x) + Q(x) = Q(x) + P(x).
Use the associative property to group terms of the same degree in any order.
Remove the parentheses first when adding or subtracting polynomials horizontally.
According to the bracket rule, change the signs of terms when removing parentheses preceded by a minus sign.

dlg.text: Welcome! Today we perform polynomial addition. What is our first step when adding horizontally?
We use the bracket rule to remove parentheses, and then we group and simplify like terms together!
Excellent, Tron! And is there another way to do this without writing a long horizontal line?
Yes! We can set up a vertical column addition. We just need to align terms of the same degree!
Spot on, Vuong! Can you show us how to add the columns?
We align x³ with x³, and x² with x². Then we add their coefficients vertically. It's so clean!
Outstanding! You have mastered horizontal grouping and vertical alignment. Algebra in English is exceptionally logical!
Yes, Mr. Pi! Simplifying polynomials is so logical and fun!

lessons.vi: Phép nhân đa thức một biến
lessons.focus: Mastering polynomial multiplication and solving real-world problems

cards.ex: To multiply a monomial by a polynomial, we multiply the monomial by each term of the polynomial.
We can perform polynomial multiplication by using either horizontal grouping or vertical column multiplication.
The product of the monomial 2x³ and the monomial −5x² is equal to −10x⁵.
The expression −2x³ is a monomial with a coefficient of −2 and a degree of 3.
A single-variable polynomial is a sum of monomials of the same variable.
The polynomial 3x² − 8x + 1 has three terms: 3x², −8x, and 1.
When multiplying two monomials, we multiply their coefficients and add the exponents of the variables.
In this lesson, we only perform calculations on polynomials containing a single variable x.
When multiplying a polynomial of degree 3 by a polynomial of degree 2, the resulting product has a degree of 5.
We utilize the distributive property of multiplication over addition.
The order of multiplying two polynomials does not affect their product.
We can group polynomials in different ways when multiplying three or more of them.
After performing the multiplication, we must combine like terms to simplify the final polynomial.
It is recommended to arrange the terms in descending powers of the variable.

cards.vi: các hạng tử đồng dạng / cùng bậc
cards.ex: Combine like terms such as −5x² and 6x².

cards.vi: đặt tính nhân / nhân theo cột dọc
cards.ex: We can set up a vertical multiplication to calculate the product of two long polynomials clearly.
Always align the terms of the same degree vertically in the same column.
In the age-guessing game, you first take your age, add 1, and then square the result.
We can prove the age-guessing trick using the algebraic identity.
Expand the expression x³(x + 2) to obtain the simplified polynomial x⁴ + 2x³.

dlg.text: Hello class! Today we learn how to multiply a monomial by a polynomial. How do we do that?
We apply the distributive property! We multiply the monomial by each term of the polynomial, Mr. Pi!
Exactly, Tron! Vuong, can you multiply these terms and simplify the product?
Yes! We get 6x³ − 10x² + 2x. It is already simplified and arranged in descending powers!
Superb! Now, what about multiplying a polynomial by a polynomial? Like (x + 1)(x − 1)?
We multiply each term of the first polynomial by each term of the second. The product is x² − 1!
Excellent! This is the secret of our age-guessing trick: (x + 1)² − (x − 1)² = 4x. Just divide your final result by 4 to find your age!
Wow! Understanding polynomial multiplication in English is so cool and logical!

lessons.en: DIVISION OF POLYNOMIALS IN ONE VARIABLE
lessons.vi: Phép chia đa thức một biến

cards.ex: In the division 6x⁴ : (−2x³) = −3x, the monomial 6x⁴ is the dividend.
The divisor in the expression (x³ − 3x² + x − 1) : (x² − 3x) is the binomial x² − 3x.
When we divide the monomial 12x³ by 4x, the resulting quotient is 3x².
The remainder of the division (x³ − 3x² + x − 1) : (x² − 3x) is the linear expression x − 1.
The expression 2x⁴ − 13x³ + 15x² + 11x − 3 is a polynomial in one variable x.
The term −2x³ is a monomial because it is a product of a number and a power of a variable.
Identify each term of the polynomial 5x³ − 3x² − x + 7 before setting up the division.
The degree of the polynomial dividend must be greater than or equal to the degree of the divisor.
When dividing monomials, we first divide their coefficients and then divide their variables.
In Lesson 28, we only study the division of polynomials containing a single variable x.
Write the quotient of variables as a power of x by subtracting their exponents: x⁴ : x³ = x⁴⁻³ = x¹.
To divide variables, subtract the exponent of the divisor from the exponent of the dividend.
A polynomial A is divisible by B if the division has a remainder of zero.
In an exact division of polynomials, we can write the relationship as A = B · Q.
When performing division with remainder, we can write the formula as A = B · Q + R.
We use long division to divide one multi-term polynomial by another step-by-step.
Align the terms of the same degree vertically before subtracting during polynomial division.
Leave a blank space for any missing power of x when writing down the dividend.

cards.vi: hạng tử có bậc cao nhất
cards.ex: In each step, divide the highest-degree term of the dividend by the highest-degree term of the divisor.
Simplify the resulting algebraic expression by combining any like terms after multiplying.

dlg.text: Welcome! Let's divide this polynomial by a monomial. Tron, how do we begin?
We divide each term of the dividend by the divisor −2x³, Mr. Pi!
Excellent! And what is the quotient for the second term, −2x³ divided by −2x³?
A term divided by itself is exactly 1, Mr. Pi! So the final quotient is −3x + 1!
Outstanding! Since the remainder is zero, this is an exact division. You both have mastered Lesson 28!
Hooray! Dividing polynomials in English is incredibly logical and easy to explain!

lessons.vi: Làm quen với biến cố

cards.ex: An event is any phenomenon or occurrence in nature and life whose outcome we observe.
Rolling a number less than 7 on a standard six-sided die is a certain event.
Rolling a 7 on a standard six-sided die is an impossible event.
Flipping a coin and getting heads is a random event because we cannot predict it with certainty.
We select a random card from a deck of ten numbered cards without looking.
The probability of a certain event is always 1, while that of an impossible event is 0.
There are six possible outcomes when rolling a standard cubical die.
Tossing a coin or rolling a die is a classic random experiment in statistics.
The event will occur if the drawn card displays an even number.
A fair coin has two distinct sides: a heads side and a tails side.
A standard die is a small cube with faces numbered from one to six.
When you toss a fair coin, the chance of getting tails is exactly 50%.
We measure the likelihood of an event occurring using a decimal value between 0 and 1.
It is certain that water will boil when heated to 100°C under normal conditions.
It is impossible for February to contain 31 days under any calendar system.
An empty box is filled with four cards carrying the numbers 1, 2, 3, and 6.
If you draw a card randomly from the box, what is the chance of getting a prime number?
A bag contains five white marbles and five black marbles of identical size.
The number of dots on the top face of the rolled die indicates the final outcome.
It is currently impossible to predict the exact time a landslide will occur during heavy rainfall.

dlg.text: Good morning class! Today we learn about events. If we roll this standard die, what is the chance of getting a number?
Every possible outcome is a number from 1 to 6, Mr. Pi! It is bound to happen!
Excellent, Tron! Since rolling a number less than 7 will always occur, we call it a certain event!
Yes! Its probability of occurring is exactly equal to 1!
Spot on! Now, Vuong, what if I ask for the event of rolling number 7 on this die?
That can never occur because a standard die only has numbers 1 to 6. It is an impossible event, sir!
Brilliant! An impossible event has a probability of 0. What about rolling an even number?
That is a random event! It may or may not occur. Learning events in English is so logical and fun!

lessons.en: INTRODUCTION TO PROBABILITY OF AN EVENT
lessons.vi: Làm quen với xác suất của biến cố

cards.ex: The probability of an event is a number between 0 and 1 that measures how likely it is to happen.
An event is any possible occurrence or outcome from a random experiment or activity.
The event of getting a number less than 7 when rolling a standard die is a certain event (P = 1).
Drawing a red ball from a bag containing only blue and black balls is an impossible event (P = 0).
Landing on red on a spinning wheel is a random event because we cannot be sure of the result beforehand.
Landing on heads or tails when tossing a symmetric coin are equally likely events (each has a 50% chance).
The likelihood of rain tomorrow is reported to be 80% according to the weather forecast.
A fair coin ensures that both heads and tails have an equal probability of 1/2 when tossed.
Since we use a fair die, the probability of rolling a 2 is exactly 1/6.
The coin landed on heads, meaning the other side, tails, was facing downwards.
In Vietnam's 5000 VND coin, the side showing the numerical value represents tails.
Nam randomly drew a marble from the box containing thirteen red and seven black marbles.
After 10 trials, we calculate the experimental probability based on the number of actual successes.
We can mathematically measure the chance of winning the Vietlott 6/45 jackpot as a tiny fraction.
The football experts analyze past performances to predict who has the higher probability of winning the match.
There are only six possible outcomes when rolling a standard die once, which are {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}.
For a coin toss, the complete set of outcomes contains only two elements: {Heads, Tails}.

cards.vi: vòng quay / kim chỉ vòng quay
cards.ex: In the lucky wheel game, the spinner arrow stopped on the sector representing a Rubik prize.
The probability of choosing a winning door out of three options is expressed as the fraction 1/3.
We can express a probability of 1/2 as a percentage, which is exactly 50%.

dlg.text: Hello class! Today we learn to measure the likelihood of events. What does a 43% chance of rain mean?
It is the probability written as a percentage, Mr. Pi! It means rain is moderately likely to happen!
Correct, Vuong! Now, if we toss a fair coin, what is the probability of landing on heads?
Heads and tails are equally likely outcomes! So the probability of heads is exactly 1/2 or 50%!
Superb, Vuong! Now, if we randomly draw a marble from this bag, which event has a higher probability?
Drawing a red marble has a higher probability because there are more red marbles than black ones!
Outstanding! You have mastered Lesson 30 perfectly! Measuring chance in English is extremely elegant!
Yes, Mr. Pi! Probability is so logical and super fun to explain in English!

lessons.note: Lưu ý: ở thẻ 10–11, tài liệu gốc ghi heads = “mặt ngửa” và tails = “mặt sấp”, ngược với Bài 42 sách Toán 6 (heads = mặt sấp). Giữ nguyên như bản in; nên đối chiếu SGK.

lessons.en: RELATION BETWEEN ANGLES AND OPPOSITE SIDES IN A TRIANGLE
lessons.vi: Quan hệ giữa góc và cạnh đối diện trong một tam giác
lessons.focus: Understanding the relation between angles and opposite sides in a triangle

cards.ex: In △ABC, the opposite angle to the base side BC is the interior angle ∠A.
The opposite side to the largest interior angle in any triangle is always the longest side.
In the right-angled △ABC at A, the hypotenuse BC is the longest side.
If we have the inequality AC > AB > BC, then the segment AC is the longest side of △ABC.
In △ABC, the side opposite the smallest angle is always the shortest side.
The largest angle of an obtuse triangle is always the obtuse angle itself, which is greater than 90°.
Since BC is the shortest side of the triangle, its opposite angle ∠A must be the smallest angle.
An obtuse triangle is a triangle containing one obtuse interior angle.
In a right triangle, the other two acute angles must add up to exactly 90°.
An acute triangle has three acute interior angles, each measuring less than 90°.
We can compare the lengths of sides AB and AC by comparing their opposite angle measures.
Order the angles ∠A, ∠B, and ∠C from smallest to largest based on side lengths.
Theorem 1 states that in any triangle, the angle opposite the longer side is the larger angle.
The converse theorem allows us to deduce that the side opposite the larger angle is the longer side.
Let the three players stand at the vertices A, B, and C of the soccer field.
The sum of the three interior angles of any triangle is always equal to 180°.
Angle ∠ACD is an obtuse angle because its measure is greater than 90°.
The right angle is represented by a small square corner symbol in geometry.
The measure of angle ∠B on the chalkboard is eighty degrees (80°).
We need to compare the distance from the ball at point D to the players at A, B, and C.

dlg.text: Hello class! The ball is at point D, and three players stand collinear at A, B, and C. If the angle ACD is obtuse, who is the furthest from the ball?
Let me look! Since they are collinear and ∠ACD is obtuse, △ACD has an obtuse angle at C!
Excellent, Tron! Since ∠ACD is obtuse, what can we say about the side opposite to it?
The opposite side is AD! Since the largest angle is obtuse, AD must be the longest side of △ACD!
Spot on, Tron! Vuong, how does this help us find who is closer or further?
Because AD > CD, Player 4 at A is further from the ball than Player 3 at C! Distance AD is greater!
Brilliant work, Vuong and Tron! Player 4 at A is indeed the furthest, and Player 3 at C is the closest!
Hooray! Comparing distances using interior angles in English is super fun!

lessons.en: RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN PERPENDICULAR AND OBLIQUE LINES
lessons.vi: Quan hệ giữa đường vuông góc và đường xiên

cards.ex: Draw the perpendicular line AH from point A to the straight line d.
The segment AH is the perpendicular segment from point A to line d.
Any line segment AM drawn from point A to line d, where M ≠ H, is called an oblique line.
Point H is the foot of the perpendicular dropped from A to the line d.

cards.t: distance from a point to a line
cards.ipa: /ˈdɪs.təns frɒm ə pɔɪnt tuː ə laɪn/
cards.vi: khoảng cách từ một điểm đến một đường thẳng
cards.ex: The length of the perpendicular segment AH is the distance from point A to line d.
The perpendicular segment AH is the shortest path among all segments drawn from A to line d.
Let A be a point that does not lie on the straight line d.
The line d extends infinitely in both directions on our coordinate plane.
The perpendicular AH, the oblique line AM, and segment HM form a right triangle AHM.
In triangle AHM, the oblique line AM is the hypotenuse, which is the longest side.
The perpendicular segment AH is a leg of the right triangle AHM, so AH < AM.
This theorem describes the geometric relationship between perpendiculars and oblique lines.
A segment has a finite length and connects two endpoints.

cards.vi: bất đẳng thức / quan hệ không bằng nhau
cards.ex: The inequality AH < AM holds true for any oblique line AM from point A.
Since AH is perpendicular to d, the angle ∠AHM is exactly 90°.
Use long division to divide one multi-term polynomial by another step-by-step.
Align the terms of the same degree vertically before subtracting during polynomial division.
Leave a blank space for any missing power of x when writing down the dividend.

cards.vi: hạng tử có bậc cao nhất
cards.ex: In each step, divide the highest-degree term of the dividend by the highest-degree term of the divisor.
Simplify the resulting algebraic expression by combining any like terms.

dlg.text: Hello class! Let's swim across the pool from point O. Which path OA, OB, or OC should Nam take to cross fastest?
He should choose the lane that has the shortest length, Mr. Pi!
Excellent, Tron! Since OA is perpendicular to the side, what do we call segment OA?
OA is the perpendicular segment! It represents the shortest distance from point O to the line!
Spot on! And how do we classify the other lanes OB and OC?
They are oblique lines, Mr. Pi! In the right triangle OAB, OB is the hypotenuse, which is always longer than the leg OA (OB > OA)!
Outstanding! You have mastered Lesson 32. The perpendicular segment is indeed the shortest path! Geometry in English is so logical!
Yes, Mr. Pi! Comparing segments using right triangles is super clear and fun!

lessons.en: RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE THREE SIDES OF A TRIANGLE
lessons.vi: Quan hệ giữa ba cạnh của một tam giác. Bất đẳng thức tam giác

cards.ex: A triangle is formed by three line segments connecting three non-collinear points.
Let a, b, and c represent the lengths of the three sides of the triangle.
The length of side AB in this exercise is exactly 5 cm.
An inequality uses symbols like < or > to compare two mathematical expressions.
The triangle inequality states that AB < AC + BC for any triangle ABC.
The sum of the lengths of any two sides must be strictly greater than the third side.
The length of any side of a triangle is always greater than the difference of the other two sides.
To check if three lengths can form a triangle, compare the longest side with the sum of the other two.
The shortest side of the triangle measures 2 cm in this geometric model.
Three segments of lengths 2 cm, 4 cm, and 7 cm cannot form a triangle.
We test if the triple (5, 15, 25) satisfies the three triangle inequalities.
A triangle is composed of three straight line segments meeting at three vertices.
Use the shortest side and the difference of the other two sides to verify if a triangle exists.
The length of any segment connecting a vertex to the opposite side is smaller than the semiperimeter.
If three points are collinear, they lie on a single straight line and cannot form a triangle.
For any interior point M of △ABC, the inequality MA + MB < CA + CB holds true.
Let N be the intersection of the line AM and the side BC.
Placing the utility pole C on the straight segment AB guarantees the shortest wire path.
We need to drag an electrical wire from the transformer substation at A to the neighborhood at B.
Locating the utility pole C on the river bank requires solving a triangle inequality optimization.

dlg.text: Good morning class! We need to place a utility pole C on the river bank to connect substation A to village B. How do we minimize the total wire length CA + CB?
We want the sum of CA and CB to be the shortest possible path!
Indeed! If C is not on the straight line AB, they form triangle ABC. What inequality applies to its three sides?
According to the triangle inequality, the sum of two sides is greater than the third, so CA + CB > AB!
Excellent, Vuong! So if CA + CB is always greater than AB when they form a triangle, when is the sum exactly equal to AB?
When the points A, C, and B are collinear! In that case, the utility pole C lies right on the segment AB!
Spot on! The straight line path is the shortest! You have mastered Lesson 33 and solved a real engineering problem!
Wow! Applying the triangle inequality in English is incredibly logical and practical!

lessons.en: CONCURRENCE OF THREE MEDIANS AND THREE ANGLE BISECTORS
lessons.vi: Sự đồng quy của ba đường trung tuyến, ba đường phân giác trong một tam giác

cards.ex: The expression P(x) = x⁴ + 3x³ − 5x² + 7x is a polynomial.
The polynomial A(x) = 2x² + 6x is a one-variable polynomial with variable x.
The addition of two polynomials can be done by grouping like terms.
Be careful with the signs of coefficients when performing polynomial subtraction.
Find the sum P(x) + Q(x) by adding the coefficients of like terms.
The difference between two polynomials P(x) and Q(x) is written as P(x) − Q(x).
The polynomial 2x³ − 5x² + 7 consists of three distinct terms.
Group like terms together such as 3x³ and −x³ before simplifying.
In the algebraic term −5x², the coefficient is the real number −5.
The polynomial P(x) uses the letter x as its main variable.
The degree of the polynomial 2x³ − 5x² + 7 is three.

cards.vi: đặt thẳng hàng / đặt thẳng cột
cards.ex: Align the terms of the same degree vertically before performing addition.
Add or subtract the coefficients in each vertical column to get the result.
To find the sum, add the corresponding coefficients of like terms.
Subtract the coefficients of each column when doing vertical polynomial subtraction.
Group all like terms together and simplify the resulting polynomial.
Polynomial addition satisfies the commutative property: P(x) + Q(x) = Q(x) + P(x).
Use the associative property to group terms of the same degree in any order.
Remove the parentheses first when adding or subtracting polynomials horizontally.
According to the bracket rule, change the signs of terms when removing parentheses preceded by a minus sign.

dlg.text: Hello class! Today we learn about concurrent lines in a triangle. Look! How does this triangle balance perfectly on my pencil?
Wow, it is in perfect equilibrium, Mr. Pi! How did you determine that balancing point?
Excellent question, Tron! This point is the centroid, which is the intersection of the three medians!
Ah! So the median is the segment connecting a vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side!
Precisely, Vuong! And by our theorem, the centroid lies at exactly two-thirds of the distance from each vertex. If the median is 6 cm, how far is it from the vertex?
Two-thirds of 6 is 4! So the distance from the vertex to the centroid is 4 cm!
Brilliant! Now, if we draw the three angle bisectors instead, they are concurrent at the incenter, which is equidistant from all sides!
Geometry in English is beautiful! We love concurrent lines!

dlg.text: Hello class! Three brothers want to drill a common water well. It must be equidistant from their three houses. Where should they place it?
Since the well is equidistant from A, B, and C, we must find the circumcenter of the triangle, Mr. Pi!
Excellent, Tron! And how do we find the circumcenter O?
We draw the three perpendicular bisectors of the sides. They are concurrent at the circumcenter O!
Now, Vuong, if we draw the three altitudes instead, where do they meet?
They meet at the orthocenter H! In an acute triangle, H is inside. In a right triangle, H is at the right-angle vertex!
Outstanding! The circumcenter O is equidistant from the vertices, and the orthocenter H depends on the type of triangle. Triangles are full of beauty!

lessons.vi: Hình hộp chữ nhật và hình lập phương

cards.ex: A rectangular prism has 6 rectangular faces, 8 vertices, and 12 edges.
A cube is a special rectangular prism where all 6 faces are equal squares.
A rectangular prism has exactly 8 vertices, which are the corner points.
A cube has 12 edges, and all of these edges have the same length a.
A rectangular prism has 4 space diagonals connecting opposite vertices.
Every rectangular prism has 6 flat faces, including 2 bases and 4 lateral faces.
The 4 vertical sides of this room are its lateral faces.
A rectangular prism has 2 parallel and congruent bases at the top and bottom.
The height of this cardboard box is 15 cm.
The length of the base of the rectangular fish tank is 80 cm.
The width of the base of the rectangular box is 50 cm.
Draw the flat net of the rectangular prism on cardboard before folding it into a box.
The lateral area of a rectangular prism is S_xq = 2(a + b)c, where c is the height.
The total surface area is the sum of the lateral area and the areas of its two bases.
The volume of a rectangular prism is calculated by the formula V = a · b · c.
The capacity of this milk carton is 50 centilitres.
A rectangular prism has three dimensions: length, width, and height.
Nam constructed a cube using a steel frame of 12 rods.
Make sure all dimensions are converted to the same unit of measurement before finding the volume.
The perimeter of the base is the sum of the four base edges.

dlg.text: Hello class! Today we learn Lesson 36. What do you think this flat cardboard represents?
That is a net! If we fold it along the crease lines, we can make a 3D box, Mr. Pi!
Indeed, Tron! Now that you folded it, what 3D figure do you have?
We have a rectangular prism! It has exactly 6 flat faces, 8 vertices, and 12 edges!
Excellent! And Vuong, if the length is 10 cm, the width is 10 cm, and the height is 15 cm, how do we find its volume?
We multiply its three dimensions: V = 10 · 10 · 15. The volume is exactly 1500 cm³!
Outstanding! You have mastered Lesson 36. The perpendicular segment is indeed the shortest path!
Learning geometry in English is so visual, logical, and extremely fun!

cards.vi: hình lăng trụ đứng tam giác
cards.ex: An A-frame calendar or a tent can have the shape of a triangular prism.

cards.vi: hình lăng trụ đứng tứ giác
cards.ex: A rectangular prism and a cube are both special types of quadrilateral prisms.
A right prism has two bases that are parallel and congruent polygons.
All lateral faces of a right prism are rectangles perpendicular to the bases.
All lateral edges of a right prism are parallel to each other and equal in length.
The boundary lines of the top and bottom faces are called the base edges.
A triangular prism has six vertices, whereas a quadrilateral prism has eight.
The height of a right prism is the perpendicular distance between its two parallel bases.
Draw the flat net of the triangular prism on a sheet before cutting and folding it.
The formula to calculate the lateral area is S_xq = C · h, where C is the base perimeter.
The total surface area of a closed prism is the sum of the lateral area and twice the base area.
The volume of a prism is V = S_base · h.
To find the lateral area, first calculate the base perimeter by adding all base edges.
The base area is calculated using the specific geometric formula.
A right prism with a right triangle base is common in many physics applications.
A wooden chock block has a prism shape with a base that is an isosceles trapezoid.
Check that all dimensions are in the same unit before calculating the volume.
The two bases of a prism are parallel and will never intersect.
The two base faces of a right prism must be congruent polygons.
The cross-section parallel to the base is congruent to the base itself.

dlg.text: Hello class! Today we learn Lesson 37. What 3D figure can we fold from this flat cardboard net?
That is the net of a triangular prism, Mr. Pi! If we fold it, we get a triangular right prism!
Indeed, Tron! Now that you folded it, how many faces does this right prism have?
It has exactly 5 faces in total, including 2 parallel triangular bases and 3 rectangular lateral faces!
Excellent! And Vuong, if the base is a right triangle with legs of 6 cm and 8 cm, and the height is 15 cm, how do we find its volume?
First, the base area is S_base = 1/2 · 6 · 8 = 24 cm². Then we multiply by height: V = 24 · 15!
Outstanding! The volume is exactly 360 cm³! You have mastered Lesson 37 perfectly today!
Hooray! Explaining 3D geometry in English is so visual, logical, and extremely fun!
